text_a: The invoice was paid on Friday, wasn't it?
text_b: The invoice was paid on Friday, right?

text_a: El cliente aceptó el presupuesto, ¿no?
text_b: El cliente no aceptó el presupuesto, ¿verdad?
what_differs: The speaker's assumed polarity flips from accepted to not accepted.

text_a: A reunião com a diretoria é às dez, não é?
text_b: A reunião com a diretoria é às dez, certo?

text_a: Ya cerraste la caja, ¿no?
text_b: ¿No cerraste ya la caja?
what_differs: The negative question can be a confirmation request or a reproach that the till was not closed.

text_a: Keep the cooler doors open during the inspection.
text_b: Keep the cooler doors closed during the inspection.
what_differs: Open is replaced by its opposite, closed.

text_a: El acceso al archivo está restringido al personal de contabilidad.
text_b: El acceso al archivo está limitado al personal de contabilidad.

text_a: Aumente a temperatura do forno depois de 20 minutos.
text_b: Diminua a temperatura do forno depois de 20 minutos.
what_differs: Increase is replaced by decrease.

text_a: Do not accept late submissions.
text_b: Reject late submissions.

text_a: Debes adjuntar el certificado médico a la solicitud.
text_b: Puedes adjuntar el certificado médico a la solicitud.
what_differs: Obligation becomes mere permission.

text_a: Staff should have completed the safety training by June.
text_b: Staff were required to complete the safety training by June.
what_differs: 'Should have' can read as an expectation about the past or as a binding deadline.

text_a: É obrigatório o uso de capacete na obra.
text_b: Na obra, o capacete tem de ser usado.

text_a: No es necesario que entregues el informe hoy.
text_b: Es necesario que no entregues el informe hoy.
what_differs: Absence of obligation becomes a prohibition.

text_a: I only told Maria about the layoffs.
text_b: I told only Maria about the layoffs.
what_differs: Preverbal 'only' may restrict the person, the action, or the topic.

text_a: Solo los gerentes pueden aprobar gastos de viaje.
text_b: Los gerentes solo pueden aprobar gastos de viaje.
what_differs: Restriction moves from who approves to what managers may approve.

text_a: Apenas os sócios podem usar a piscina aos domingos.
text_b: Somente os sócios podem usar a piscina aos domingos.

text_a: Refund only the shipping cost to customers who complained.
text_b: Refund the shipping cost only to customers who complained.
what_differs: Restriction moves from what is refunded to who receives the refund.

text_a: Primero apaga el equipo y luego desconecta el cable.
text_b: Desconecta el cable después de apagar el equipo.

text_a: Notify the client once the contract is signed.
text_b: Notify the client before the contract is signed.
what_differs: Notification moves from after signing to before signing.

text_a: Salve o arquivo e feche o programa antes de sair.
text_b: Salve o arquivo antes de sair e feche o programa.
what_differs: It is unclear whether 'antes de sair' covers both actions or only one.

text_a: En cuanto llegue el técnico, avísame.
text_b: Avísame apenas llegue el técnico.

text_a: Send the report to Ana and Luis or Carmen.
text_b: Send the report to Ana, and to either Luis or Carmen.
what_differs: Text A can group as (Ana and Luis) or Carmen, or as Ana and (Luis or Carmen).

text_a: Ni el director ni la subdirectora firmarán el acta.
text_b: El director no firmará el acta, y la subdirectora tampoco.

text_a: Você pode levar a mochila ou a mala.
text_b: Você pode levar a mochila e a mala.
what_differs: Permission for one item becomes permission for both.

text_a: Para el trámite se requiere el pasaporte o la cédula.
text_b: Para el trámite se requieren el pasaporte y la cédula.
what_differs: One of two documents becomes both documents.

text_a: El auditorio tiene capacidad para 1.500 personas.
text_b: El auditorio tiene capacidad para mil quinientas personas.

text_a: The meeting will last about 90 minutes.
text_b: The meeting will last exactly an hour and a half.
what_differs: An approximate duration becomes an exact one.

text_a: Compre uma dúzia de ovos para o bolo.
text_b: Compre 12 ovos para o bolo.

text_a: The deposit is 2.500 euros.
text_b: The deposit is 2,500 euros.
what_differs: '2.500' can be read as two and a half or as two thousand five hundred.

text_a: Cancela la reunión del jueves con proveedores.
text_b: Pospón la reunión del jueves con proveedores.
what_differs: Canceling removes the meeting; postponing reschedules it.

text_a: Pass this email along to the legal team.
text_b: Forward this email to the legal team.

text_a: Revise o contrato antes de sexta-feira.
text_b: Aprove o contrato antes de sexta-feira.
what_differs: Reviewing does not commit to approving.

text_a: Échale un vistazo a la propuesta.
text_b: Revisa la propuesta por encima.

text_a: Approve the leave request even if the team is short-staffed.
text_b: Approve the leave request if the team is not short-staffed.
what_differs: A concession that always approves becomes a condition that blocks approval when understaffed.

text_a: Puedes usar el coche de la empresa siempre que lo devuelvas con el depósito lleno.
text_b: Puedes usar el coche de la empresa con tal de que lo devuelvas con el depósito lleno.

text_a: Ligue para mim se precisar de alguma coisa.
text_b: Ligue para mim somente se precisar de alguma coisa.
what_differs: Readers disagree on whether plain 'se' is pragmatically read as 'only if'.

text_a: Lock the server room whenever you leave it.
text_b: Lock the server room unless you are leaving it.
what_differs: The condition for locking is inverted.

text_a: Ya no aceptamos pagos con cheque.
text_b: Dejamos de aceptar pagos con cheque.

text_a: All the candidates didn't pass the test.
text_b: None of the candidates passed the test.
what_differs: Text A can mean 'not all passed' or 'none passed'.

text_a: O sistema ainda não foi atualizado.
text_b: O sistema não é mais atualizado.
what_differs: 'Not yet updated' implies a pending update; 'no longer updated' means updates stopped.

text_a: Rara vez se cancela este vuelo.
text_b: Este vuelo casi nunca se cancela.
